law_name: Act on the Fund Corporation for the Overseas Development of Japan's ICT and Postal Services
law_name_original: Act on the Fund Corporation for the Overseas Development of Japan's ICT and Postal Services
text_en: The Fund Corporation for the Overseas Development of Japan's ICT and Postal Services is a stock company whose purpose is to contribute to sustainable growth of the national economy, as a result of efforts to improve the profitability of business operators in Japan who respond to the relevant demands, through the expansion of common demand for communication, broadcasting and postal businesses in Japan and overseas, by providing funds and other support for persons, etc. engaged in communication, broadcasting and postal businesses overseas, utilizing the knowledge, technology and experience accumulated by Japanese business operators.
